browser.description: Browser that draws the PDF: chrome, msedge, chromium, a preview channel such as chrome-beta, or the full path to a browser program. Empty: Chrome, then Edge, then the downloaded Chromium.

settings_file.description: Full path to a markdown-pdf-export settings file to use instead of the shared one (~/.config/markdown-pdf-export/settings.json, or %APPDATA%\markdown-pdf-export\settings.json on Windows). Studio always edits the shared file. Empty: the shared file.

debug.description: Write a debug log to markdown-pdf-debug.log in the temp folder.
